source_evidence: Exact player 'Good, run this by lady Ysendre. She will run the place while I am gone, under the understanding we operate inder a free market' approves revised objective progressive tax draft as basis for submission to Caul and directs interim management during V absence under free-market principles. Interpret 'the place' as coordinating V's western regional interests (tower and liaison with Silverward, plus Caul's own existing manor administration), not displacement of actual Hessa/Voss stewardship, unrestricted sovereignty or transfer of other estates. Caul's acceptance of this interim remit still pending actual receipt/response; prior conditional future recognition of her as House steward on proven voluntary reform remains, not silently superseded by unconditional fealty or absolution. Voss prepares copy of revised draft (annual household taxable earned income/net business profits/rents; documented direct business costs only; no subjective personal living deductions; first50gp0%, next100gp5%, next250gp10%, next600gp15%, excess1000gp20%; proposed360-day fiscal period,90-day cumulative settlement; single liability settled in coin/agreed goods or voluntarily chosen fair-value labor/blood under consent/safety safeguards; no fixed blood price or recipient); accompanies with V's instruction of free-market economic development, voluntary residence/departure, lawful open trade/competition, property rights, fair contracted wages/leases, no arbitrary changes, coerced labor/blood, magical compulsion or punitive exit restrictions. Voss retains local tower duties and Hessa retains Silverward duties; separate accounts and actual funds, Caul proposed regional coordination, no new wage, appointment accepted by Caul, pooled funds, additional transfer or compulsory authority. Approved draft for consultation/implementation only where actual lawful authority exists; no Crown tax change, current territorial jurisdiction, compulsory levy, numeric blood valuation, enacted tax assessment, new settlement or revenue. Voss hands copy and letter to existing manor yard Guard courier who delivered release order earlier and has rested at tower since dawn; courier willingly departs for manor at D335~15:50,12 rough miles/8h, earliest uninterrupted arrival23:50, actual delivery/acceptance/reply pending; no extra courier or replacement guard, no new V cost. Voss keeps counterpart. Caul trial remains conditional and no actual implementation/results established. Existing tower possession and signed handover, freed captives and outstanding restitution unaffected. V next action; rations/feed remain zero, provisioning required before travel. Day335~15:50. No roll for ordinary delegated preparation, voluntary courier return, or drafting; no resource use/rest/expenditure.

Caul's unlawful dues terminated, prior patrol returned, no further unauthorized collection, verification and restitution remain. LR4/6 purse2037gp8sp6cp rations0/feed0 after D335 consumption. Silverward conditional grant not deed, Hessa5gp/actual workday starts332, actual work/payroll/funding/inspection/results pending, six undead retainers unpaid voluntary labor/protection, resident independent ferry/home rights intact, drainage restored, ledge/structural/parcel verification pending. Mara holds 2 incised leaves, ceramic container, one historic coffer~180gp metal-equivalent/keepsakes in safekeeping/valuation custody not cash/title; copies from Silverward, tower, manor registers and historical approach sketch with Mara/Cirren. V holds signed tower relinquishment original. Caul personally recognizes V as Sovereign's child; father's name/fate, other parent, sealing cause, heart function and seat location unresolved.
